abilities.name: Total Mayhem
abilities.description: Upon dying, drop 5 grenades that explode after 0.75 seconds, each dealing 250 damage to nearby enemies. Deals 75% less damage to Structures.

fields.notes: Grenades are dropped at 5 points, randomly selected out of 10 preset locations, around Junkrat's death location over 0.3125 seconds. Junkrat's Basic Attacks Splash, dealing 100% of their damage in 2 radius.

abilities.name: Detonate Mine
abilities.description: Detonate the planted Concussion Mine, dealing 180 damage to nearby enemies and knocking them back. Junkrat can also be affected by Concussion Mine, but takes no damage.

abilities.name: Frag Launcher
abilities.description: Launch a grenade that explodes at the end of its path or upon hitting an enemy, dealing 124 damage to nearby enemies. Grenades can ricochet off of terrain. Deals 50% less damage to Structures. Stores up to 4 charges. Frag Launcher's cooldown replenishes all charges at the same time.; 12 / 0.5

fields.notes: If the grenade lands on unpathable terrain, it explodes immediately without bouncing. Enemies that are immune to skillshots cannot trigger the grenades, but can be damaged by the explosion. Depending on the distance, launched grenades have a flight time of up to 0.625 seconds. Grenades have a set rolling distance regardless of launch distance. Rolling speed gradually decelerates over the distance down to 1.75.

abilities.name: Concussion Mine
abilities.description: Place a mine on the ground. Junkrat's Trait can be activated to detonate the mine, dealing 180 damage to nearby enemies and knocking them back. Junkrat can also be affected by Concussion Mine, but takes no damage. Limit 1 active mine.

fields.props: Area of Effect, Clamping, Summon figment, Displacement, Daze
fields.notes: Concussion Mine takes 0.125-0.75 seconds to reach the target location, based on distance to target point. The mine is Invulnerable and untargetable and lasts indefinitely until detonation or placing another one. Concussion Mine provides vision in 3 radius. The area of effect is visible to enemies. Targets launched by Concussion Mine detonation (including Junkrat himself) are Dazed and can travel over unpathable terrain. Distance and duration of the displacement depend on how far the target is hit from the center of the Mine, with the longest being the farthest.

abilities.name: Steel Trap
abilities.description: Place a trap on the ground that arms after 2 seconds. Deals 130 damage to the first enemy that walks over it and Roots them for 2 seconds. Limit 1 active trap.

fields.notes: The trap is Invulnerable and untargetable and lasts indefinitely until triggering or placing another one. Enemy units that do not draw Minion aggro, such as passive Summons, do not trigger Steel Trap. Steel Trap provides vision in 5 radius.

abilities.name: RIP-Tire
abilities.description: Create a motorized bomb with 530 Health that lasts 15 seconds. While active, Junkrat is immobile but gains control of RIP-Tire's movement. RIP-Tire can be reactivated to detonate immediately, knocking nearby enemies back and dealing 720 damage to enemies near the center gradually reduced to 445 to enemies on the edge. RIP-Tire

fields.notes: Interrupting the ability during its windup puts it on a 10 second cooldown. While controlling RIP-Tire, Junkrat has access to Jump and Detonate RIP-Tire abilities. RIP-Tire does not detonate if it is destroyed or has expired. If Junkrat's channel gets interrupted, RIP-Tire instantly expires without detonating. The durations of crowd control effects against RIP-Tire are reduced by 75%.

abilities.name: RIP-Tire - Jump
abilities.description: Activate to make RIP-Tire jump. Can be used to pass over terrain and Structures.

fields.notes: This Ability is available while controlling RIP-Tire.

abilities.name: RIP-Tire - Detonate RIP-Tire
abilities.description: Instantly detonate the RIP-Tire, knocking nearby enemies back and dealing 720 damage to enemies near the center gradually reduced to 445 to enemies on the edge.

fields.notes: This Ability is available while controlling RIP-Tire. Base damage is reduced linearly based on the distance to the center.

abilities.name: Rocket Ride
abilities.description: After 1.25 seconds, Junkrat launches into the air. While in the air, he can steer the landing location by moving. After 3.75 seconds, Junkrat lands, dealing 935 damage to nearby enemies and activating Total Mayhem. 5 seconds after landing, Junkrat reappears at the Hall of Storms and gains 150% additional Movement Speed until dismounted.

fields.type: Spell Damage / Movement: Teleport, Status effect
fields.props: Area of Effect, Channeled cast (stationary), Clamping, Stasis
fields.notes: Interrupting the Ability during its windup puts it on a 10 second cooldown. After successfully casting Rocket Ride, Junkrat is put in Stasis until he re-emerges. In addition to usual effects of Stasis, Junkrat is removed from ground plane (disjoints certain projectiles) and has no collision. While waiting to respawn he also cannot regenerate Health, Mana, Energy or Shields and cannot be seen on the minimap or revealed.

talents.name: Tricky Shuffles
talents.description: While Frag Launcher has no charges left, gain 10% Movement Speed and his Basic Attacks deal 15% bonus damage.

fields.notes: Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers affecting Junkrat's Basic Attack damage.

talents.name: Extra-Wound Timers
talents.description: The final grenade from Frag Launcher deals 100% bonus damage, and Frag Launcher grenades last an additional 2 seconds before automatically detonating.

fields.notes: Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers affecting Frag Launcher 's damage.

_raw_fields: The final grenade from Frag Launcher deals 100% bonus damage, and Frag Launcher grenades last an additional 2 seconds before automatically detonating.

talents.name: Blow 'Em Up!
talents.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Concussion Mine or Steel Trap causes Junkrat to deal 25% more damage with Basic Attacks and Basic Abilities for 6 seconds.

fields.notes: Subsequent applications refresh the duration. Damage bonus stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers affecting Junkrat's damage output.
